Schnittstelle Appliable4<WT extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.WitnessType, A1, A2, A3, A4>

Typparameter:
WT - the witness type representing the constructor
A1 - the first carried type
A2 - the second carried type
A3 - the third carried type
A4 - the fourth carried type
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Record4, Tuple4
public interface Appliable4<WT extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.WitnessType, A1, A2, A3, A4>

Rank-4 applicative functor interface: applies functions inside the context to four carried type parameters, producing a value of the same constructor shape.

This interface is the rank-4 analog to Haskell's Applicative functor class.

Contract: the provided higher‑kinded value must not be null, must not contain null functions, and the result must not be null.

    • applyTo

      <B1,B2,B3,B4> @NonNull org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher4<WT,B1,B2,B3,B4> applyTo(@NonNull org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher4<WT, ? extends Function<? super A1, ? extends B1>, ? extends Function<? super A2, ? extends B2>, ? extends Function<? super A3, ? extends B3>, ? extends Function<? super A4, ? extends B4>> transformation)

      Applies the given functions to the four carried values in this context.

      Typparameter:
      B1 - the new first type after applying the function to A1
      B2 - the new second type after applying the function to A2
      B3 - the new third type after applying the function to A3
      B4 - the new fourth type after applying the function to A4
      Parameter:
      transformation - a Higher4 carrying the functions A1 -> B1, A2 -> B2, A3 -> B3, A4 -> B4; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a Higher4<WT, B1, B2, B3, B4> value; never null
